answer: Resist sybils by tying settlement weight to a vine of sequential, counterparty-verified jobs. A new identity starts with no rights; weight rises only after unaffiliated peers grade each job, so reputation must spiral through real work, not a burst of fresh keys. An attacker who mints a thousand sockpuppets still has to buy a full job history for each one, paying honest counterparties and waiting out non-overlapping time locks. That cost scales linearly with the farm, so unpaid clones stall and never reach the zenith where they can grade, vote, or cash out at scale.
